gizmo.title: Ajụjụ ọnụọgụ
gizmo.description: Ajụjụ a na-aza site na ọnụọgụ. Azịza ya bụ ọnụọgụ edobere ma ọ bụ usoro a gbakọrọ site na mgbanwe, ọ na-agụkwa mgbe ọ dị n'ime oke ndidi.

configure.title: Ajụjụ
configure.description: Ihe a na-ajụ ndị mmụta. Dee aha mgbanwe n'ime akara mkpọchi, dịka {d}, iji gosi uru ya.

configure.title: Nkeji
configure.description: E gosiri dịka ederede n'akụkụ ebe azịza, dịka km/h.

configure.title: Azịza
configure.description: Ọnụọgụ ziri ezi. Hapụ ya efu mgbe usoro na-agbakọ azịza ya.

configure.title: Usoro
configure.description: Na-agbakọ azịza site na mgbanwe, dịka d / (t / 60). Nwere ike iji + - * / ^, akara mkpọchi, sqrt() na abs(). A na-eji ya kama azịza mgbe etọrọ ya.

configure.title: Mgbanwe
configure.description: Ọnụọgụ usoro na ajụjụ na-eji. Nke ọ bụla na-ewere uru n'etiti nke kacha ala ya na nke kacha elu ya, na nzọụkwụ.

advanced.title: Oke ndidi
advanced.description: Otu o si dị anya site na azịza ziri ezi ma ka na-agụ. 0 pụtara kpọmkwem, ma ọ bụ e mere ka ọ bụrụ ebe ntụpọ dị n'okpuru.

advanced.title: Ụdị oke ndidi
advanced.description: Zuru oke: gbakwunye ma ọ bụ wepụ oke ndidi. Pasentị: gbakwunye ma ọ bụ wepụ pasentị ahụ nke azịza ziri ezi.

advanced.title: Ebe ntụpọ
advanced.description: A na-ajụ ndị mmụta ka ha mee ka ọ bụrụ ebe ndị a, a na-egosikwa azịza ahụ dịka ya. Hapụ ya efu maka enweghị mgbanwe.

advanced.title: Ngbalị
advanced.description: Ugboro ole onye mmụta nwere ike ilele. 0 pụtara enweghị oke.

advanced.title: Ọnụọgụ ọhụrụ na ngbalị ọ bụla
advanced.description: Wepụta uru mgbanwe ọhụrụ oge ọ bụla onye mmụta nwara ọzọ. A naghị egosi azịza ya gara aga mgbe ọ lọghachiri, naanị ma ọ ziri ezi.

advanced.title: Enwere ike ịkpachi
advanced.description: Gosi ajụjụ a dịka ahịrị na-emeghe ma na-emechi. Imeghe otu na-emechi ajụjụ ndị ọzọ enwere ike ịkpachi dị n'akụkụ ya.

advanced.title: Malite emechiri emechi
advanced.description: Mgbe enwere ike ịkpachi, malite dịka ahịrị emechiri emechi na-egosi naanị ajụjụ na ọnọdụ ya.

developer.title: Aha ajụjụ ule
developer.description: Aha ajụjụ ule e ji maka njirimara xAPI na sistemụ nyocha data.
